lane_title: Safari Web Extension Companion — GitHub Browser Context and Native Rig Relay Handoff Corridor
stated_consumer_purpose: Provide developers with a Safari browser extension that recognizes GitHub repository pages, serializes content-light context references, and hands off user intents to the native Rig Relay app through a typed message contract.
released_boundary: Safari Web Extension Companion v1: a Safari Web Extension that (1) activates on GitHub.com repository pages, (2) recognizes page context from URL structure only (no DOM scraping), (3) presents narrowly scoped actions (Open in Rig Relay, Study Repository, View Project Status), (4) sends typed, versioned, content-light handoff messages to the native messaging boundary, (5) renders truthful status for app-unavailable, unsupported-page, not-authorized, deferred, and refused states, (6) stores no GitHub credentials, raw page content, or publication authority.

constraints.description: Extension must not become a hidden GitHub authority bypass
constraints.evidence: Extension stores no tokens, calls no GitHub APIs, imports no repositories. All handoffs require native app. Content script extracts URL only — no DOM content. Zero fetch/XHR calls in background.js, content.js, popup.js. No GitHub token patterns in any JS source.

constraints.description: Extension must not store or transmit GitHub credentials
constraints.evidence: Token patterns (ghp_, ghs_, gho_, ghu_, ghr_, github_pat_) rejected at URL parsing level in both content.js (CREDENTIAL_PARAMS scan) and Python models (_TOKEN_PATTERNS regex). No fetch/XHR in extension. No localStorage usage. browser.storage.session only stores connection state (extensionReady, nativeAvailable, appStatus).

constraints.description: Extension must not scrape or expose private page content
constraints.evidence: Content script uses window.location only — never accesses DOM, innerHTML, textContent, or querySelector. All handoff payloads are URL-derived metadata only (owner, repo, page_kind, optional PR/issue number). No raw page HTML or file contents in any payload shape defined by the schema.

constraints.description: Extension must not claim live N1 messaging before N1 release
constraints.evidence: NativeMessageContract fixture is explicitly a test double (simulates app responses). Release disposition is candidate_local. Deferred seam explicitly names N1 contract consumption as a named binding milestone. No Xcode project or .appex target exists.

constraints.description: Extension popup must not duplicate Gridline frontend
constraints.evidence: Popup is 300px wide with 3 action buttons (Open in Rig Relay, Study Repository, View Project Status) and status indicators (repository detected, app connected/unavailable). No agent loop, tool execution, repository management, or projection rendering. Popup handsoff to native app — does not replicate desktop UI.

constraints.description: Extension must not silently edit N1/J0/P0 ownership boundaries
constraints.evidence: No files modified in N0, J0, P0 directories. pyproject.toml change is additive (2 PLR per-file-ignore lines for rig_relay/extensions/safari/models.py and context.py). New files are Q0-scoped only: macos/SafariExtension/, rig_relay/extensions/safari/, tests/extensions/safari/, docs/schemas/rig.relay.safari_extension_message.*, docs/json/audits/safari/.

constraints.description: All messages must be content-light — no raw page content, tokens, or credentials
constraints.evidence: Content-light validator (validate_content_light in models.py) detects 6 token patterns via _TOKEN_PATTERNS regex. Forbidden keys check rejects file_contents, html, raw_prompt, model_output. Schema enforces allowed fields only: url, owner, repo, page_kind, pr_number, issue_number, triggered_by. JSON schema validates payload shapes with additionalProperties: false on all definitions. NativeMessageContract.validate_content_light() gates all received handoffs.

constraints.description: All extension actions must require explicit user gesture
constraints.evidence: All handoffs triggered through popup button clicks (btnOpen, btnStudy, btnStatus with addEventListener('click')). triggered_by field is always 'popup_action' in current implementation. No automatic/silent message dispatch. No page load auto-handoff (content script only caches context, never sends). No timer-based triggers. No background script periodic pings.

privacy_audit.native_messaging_payloads: content-light: url, owner, repo, page_kind, optional PR/issue number, triggered_by
privacy_audit.storage_usage: browser.storage.session for connection state only (extensionReady, nativeAvailable, appStatus, lastNativeResponseTime)
privacy_audit.network_access: none — no fetch, XHR, or WebSocket in extension JS
privacy_audit.credential_leak_vectors: defended at 3 layers: content script URL sanitization (CREDENTIAL_PARAMS), background script token scan (isValidGitHubRepoURL), Python model validation (_TOKEN_PATTERNS regex and validate_content_light)
defense_in_depth_gaps: Python context._TOKEN_PATTERNS frozenset does not include 'client_secret' or 'client_id' patterns that content.js CREDENTIAL_PARAMS checks — content.js rejects these but Python context.py silently passes them; gap is in the Python recognition path, not the Safari content script path. No actual leak since content script rejects before handoff.
